agents.mission: Route proof obligations, enforce version/checkpoint discipline, coordinate the team and submit packets to AGORA.
Normalize statements, quantifiers, domains, definitions and proof obligations.
Develop a primary derivation from the normalized statement.
Seek a materially different derivation and expose shared dependencies.
Run finite symbolic/numerical checks and label them strictly as computation, never universal proof.
Attack assumptions, search edge cases/counterexamples and identify hidden dependencies.
Check every inference, quantifier, algebraic transformation and dependency without authoring the primary proof.
Reconstruct the strongest claim from a minimal clean evidence packet; imported derivation is excluded when independence is required.
Maintain evidence IDs, lineage, dependency fingerprints, contradictions and proof/computation distinctions.
Fuse only audited material into the colony egress packet; preserve dissent and unresolved obligations.

execution_policy.assignment: A slot becomes executable only after a real model/resource identity and version are recorded.
execution_policy.same_model_rule: Same model+prompt+data lineage must not be counted as independent evidence.
execution_policy.chief_rule: CHIEF routes and coordinates but cannot certify its own promotion.
execution_policy.quorum_rule: Agent count is not evidence; validation depends on gates and independence.
execution_policy.missing_slot_rule: UNASSIGNED remains UNASSIGNED; never simulate a missing teammate.

packet_flow: MISSION -> CHIEF -> FORMALIZER -> PROVER_A||PROVER_B||COMPUTE -> COUNTEREX -> AUDITOR -> REPRODUCER -> EVIDENCE -> SYNTH -> AGORA
